question: The book which keeps a record of all the endangered animals and plants is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Red Data Book**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **All endangered plants and animals **are listed in the **Red Data Book**.
 
• **Endangered animals **are those that are on the verge of extinction.
 
• The Red Data Book is a public document used to **record endangered and rare plant, animal, and fungus species**, as well as some local subspecies, that exist in a given region.
 
• The Red Data Book assists us in gathering comprehensive data for research, studies, and monitoring initiatives involving rare and endangered animals and their ecosystems.
 
• The Red Data Book is a comprehensive list of endangered species.
 
• The major goal of this documentation is to give comprehensive information for species research and analysis.
 
• The Red Data Book offers colour-coded information sheets organised by extinction danger for a variety of species and subspecies.
